ITA-9.2.53 piṇḍasvedaḥ पिण्डस्वेदः
Sweating induced by application of a poultice
Sudation achieved with the application of a poultice prepared with medicated substances.

piṇḍikā पिण्डिका
Muscular or bony prominence

ITA-9.5.38 piṇḍī पिण्डी
Eye poultice
A therapeutic procedure in which mild sudation is achieved over the eye and orbital region by filling paste or medicines into small cloth packets and applying them over the closed eyelids.

piṇyākaḥ पिण्याकः
Oil cakes
The residue of seeds which have been pressed and ground to extract their oil.
